description: This file defines a React functional component called AdminDashboard, which serves as the admin landing page for managing courses and platform content. It imports React, a custom authentication hook, and a form component for creating courses. The component displays a header, a warning message about temporary access control, and includes the CourseCreateForm component for creating new courses.

methods.name: AdminDashboard()
methods.description: A React functional component that renders the admin dashboard page with a header, a warning message, and a course creation form.
